description: This file implements the code-behind for the LoginPage ASPX page in an online examination system, handling user login functionality for students and teachers/admins.

classes.name: LoginPage
classes.description: Partial class representing the server-side logic for the login page of the online exam system.

methods.name: Page_Load
methods.description: Handles the page load event; currently empty.

methods.name: signupB
methods.description: Handles the event when the sign-up button is clicked; transfers to the sign-up page.

methods.name: loginButton_Click
methods.description: Handles the login button click event; authenticates users as students or teachers/admins and redirects accordingly.
